newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Iraqi oil liftings 11.44 mln bbl so far.
newsitem.headline: Russian Iraqi oil liftings 11.44 mln bbl so far.

text.p: Russian companies have lifted a total 11.44 million barrels of the 26.23 million barrels of Iraqi crude oil for which they have contracts over a six month period, a senior oil official said on Thursday.

Yuri Agababov, deputy chief executive of Zarubezhneft, the company coordinating the contracts, also told Reuters that a new contract signed by Rosneft last week for one million barrels was for Kirkuk oil and that lifting would begin in a couple of days.
Agababov said International Economic Cooperation, known as MES, would lift from April 1-10.
Mashinoimport would lift at the end of March or in the first half of April.
Agababov said representatives from Russian independent oil company Tatneft had held talks with SOMO in Baghdad but gave no details.
Iraq began exporting oil in December 1996 under a $2 billion U.N. oil-for-food programme to raise cash for food and medicine.
A second Zarubezhneft official, who did not wish to be identified, said all of the Russian contracts were for a six month period and gave no details on possible future contracts.
